bundle.shortDescription: Paste a video page link and get one playable MP4.
bundle.longDescription: HighVi finds the HLS stream a web page plays (with yt-dlp, or by watching the page's own player in an isolated headless Chrome), downloads it through a network guard that only allows public HTTPS destinations, and saves one MP4. It never bypasses DRM, logins or paywalls.
